_comment: Known run errors with a one-click fix. 'match' is a regular expression tested against the run error and its details. Actions: pip (install into ComfyUI's Python), update_node (git pull a custom node folder). 'restart': restart ComfyUI afterwards.

fixes.title: Library version conflict: transformers is too new
fixes.explain: The node calls CLIPTextModel.text_model, which the Hugging Face 'transformers' library removed in version 5.6. ComfyUI-HunyuanVideoWrapper (and nodes built on it) still use it. The fix installs transformers 5.5 into ComfyUI's Python and restarts ComfyUI; your models and workflows are not touched.

fixes.match: numpy\.core\.multiarray failed to import|A module that was compiled using NumPy 1\.x cannot be run in
fixes.title: Library version conflict: NumPy 2 vs. a package built for NumPy 1
fixes.explain: A package in ComfyUI's Python was built for NumPy 1.x but NumPy 2 is installed. The fix installs the last NumPy 1 release and restarts ComfyUI.

fixes.title: A Python package is missing: {module}
fixes.explain: A custom node needs the Python package '{module}', which is not installed in ComfyUI's Python. The fix installs it (pip install {package}) and restarts ComfyUI.
